Overview

Letterkenny is a city in Donegal with a population of 20,000. The largest town in County Donegal, a regional hub for the northwest with a vibrant cultural scene, the Glenveagh National Park, and stunning Atlantic coastline. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 140 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
